title: Agent Pack Project Config Schema
description: Layer 2 of the Agent Pack (C2): the bundle ships the agents and skills; the project supplies ONLY this — how to run its tests and which files force a full run. Keeps one common pipeline working for a Vitest, pytest or PHPUnit repo without hardcoding any of them. Project-owned: never overwritten on re-install.

unit_related_cmd.description: Command to run only the tests related to changed files. {files} is substituted with the changed paths. E.g. 'npx vitest related --run {files}', 'pytest --testmon', 'php artisan test --filter {files}'.

full_suite_cmd.description: Command to run the whole suite (used on hub changes and at the release gate).

integration_smoke.description: Always-run smoke checks (endpoints or scripts), cheap enough to run every change.

force_full_test_on.description: Path globs that always force the full suite when touched — DB schema/migrations, routers, middleware, shared config, lockfiles. Under-scoping a change to one of these is how a regression ships.
